notes: Owner directive: the portfolios subsystem did not support the full range of cost basis accounting, and it needs to — "we need to support all of the methods." The ledger had exactly one lot-consumption rule, FIFO, and it was a silent default: no payload said which method produced a realized number, and no recorded sale could say otherwise. Worse, the codebase carried two derivations — derive() realized P&L on a weighted-average pool while lots() computed FIFO — two routes to a realized number that quietly disagreed on any partial sale. COST-BASIS-SPEC.md fixes the design as law and this release
